hooks.text: 五个基础职业可分化为17个高级职业，独立天赋树再与会改变天赋或授予技能的装备联动。
hooks.excerpt: Having 5 basic classes with easily recognizable roles at the beginning of the playthrough, the player will be able to choose character development branches from 17 advanced classes as they gain experience. Each specialization has separate talent trees, allowing the player to create unique characters within the same class. The game has a full inventory system. Found or purchased items - weapons, armor, special equipment - can not only improve the basic characteristics of the characters, but also influence their talents or give new abilities. Experiment with the talent branches of the characters. Combine your abilities with equipment items. Create your own unique build, and conquer the world of Tenebris!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 虫群通过化学信号协调、强化和加速彼此，敌人数量越多，单个单位也越危险。
hooks.excerpt: These bugs, through chemical signals, are able not only to coordinate, but also to strengthen and accelerate each other. The more there are, the more dangerous each individual enemy is.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 坠毁星舰既是唯一安全基地，也是购买装备、唤醒新兵、治疗伤员和用任务资源扩建舱室的中心。
hooks.excerpt: The Solaris ship is your base and the only relatively safe place on the planet. Here you can purchase weapons and armor, awaken new recruits from cryo-sleep and send wounded heroes for treatment. The resources found in missions will allow you to improve the ship's bays and expand the capabilities of your squad.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
